description: Chosen extensibility tier plus the justification for it. Produced by solution-design, one per delta, paired with a design-record by the same Row ID. This is the clean-core decision.

decision_log_row_id.description: Same Row ID as the paired design-record.

extensibility_assessor_consulted.description: Whether the extensibility-assessor agent was consulted. If true, agreement/divergence with its recommendation must be stated in tier_ladder_walk or red_flags.

tier_ladder_walk.description: One entry per tier 1-5, in order, with a stated reason even for the chosen tier.

tier.description: 1=Standard configuration, 2=Key-user extension, 3=Side-by-side (BTP), 4=Developer extensibility (ABAP Cloud), 5=Classic modification (last resort).

red_flags.description: Named even if they didn't change the outcome, cross-referenced to the tier row they surfaced at.

addendum_row_id.description: The -esc-N addendum row in the fit-to-standard decision log. Record is not final for tier 5 without this.

escalation_owner.description: Distinct from the decision log's Delta owner and the sign-off record's signer.
